name: digiid-core
install: Copy packages/digiid-core from the digi-id.io repository
summary: URI helpers, key derivation and signature verification that run in browsers and Node. Powers this site's demo and playground; tested against the published vectors.

name: digiid-js
summary: Lightweight npm package for Express, Fastify, and Next.js backends. Includes native TypeScript definitions.

name: digiid-php
summary: Supports PHP 7.4+ with GMP extension. Drop-in integration for standard web servers.

name: Digi-ID for WordPress
summary: Enables passwordless sign-in for WP-Admin and subscriber logins out of the box.

name: Digi-ID for phpBB
install: Copy to ext/DigiByte/digiid and enable in the ACP
summary: Native forum authentication plugin that replaces standard login forms.
